Serves 2-4 people

## {{< fa basket-shopping >}} Ingredients

- [ ] 800 g canned whole tomatoes
- [ ] 1-3 cloves of garlic
- [ ] 1 medium onion
- [ ] 1 piece of parmesan rind
- [ ] 500 g spaghetti
- [ ] 20 g fresh basil
- [ ] Salt, pepper to taste

## {{< fa kitchen-set >}} Procedure

1.  Salt and sauté onions until translucent, but not brown
2.  Add garlic and tomato paste and roast a bit
3.  Add canned tomatoes, parmesan rind, fresh basil
4.  Let simmer on low heat for 30-120 minutes
5.  Cook pasta until al dente
6.  Mix pasta and sauce
